SELECT ch.ID, ch.GENOTYPE, pr.PARENT_GENOTYPE
FROM ECOLI_DATA ch
LEFT JOIN ECOLI_DATA pr ON ch.PARENT_ID = pr.ID
WHERE pr.GENOTYPE & ch.GENOTYPE = pr.GENTYPE
ORDER BY ch.ID
